body:
PR #4279 (STORY-2903 S1c, base integration) is ready for review at c0dde5a01da. check-ci-fast passed (rc 0), ci:full is labeled and auto-queue-review has run. The PR body has the full scope.
- One boundary, landing_merge::merge, is the only production merge_change caller (ratchet); ship, drain, burndown, release and train go through it. Non-train callers get a fresh policy, floor and authority recheck at the merge.
- The authority decision is on the gate floor: gate::ship::merge_authority_refusal (advisor merger + C2). The STORY-1888 floor ratchet caught my first version outside gate/, so I moved it.
- Review-gated mode: the advisor or operator merges. Behind-base follows your ruling (a): merge when disjoint and no protected path; otherwise refuse with update plus delta review, and protected paths also need full CI. Drain and burndown skip the CI wait; release keeps it. land run ships a READY change once when it may merge, and otherwise only reports it.
Behaviour change to check: the bug_1953 review-gated CLI test now expects the advisor-merger refusal (exit 23), because a non-advisor never reaches C2.
Not in this slice: STORY-2914 (full CI for a level protected-path head).
Next: I'll take TASK-3098 on the integration track while this is in review, unless you want S1t.
subject: PR-4279 (S1c, STORY-2903) ready for review at c0dde5a01da
